milestone: The operator command centre can now be spoken to and answers out loud. This cycle fixed three faults found by using it rather than by reading it: it did not recognise the spoken name, it gave one vague message for every kind of failure, and its priorities view had no dates on it.
readiness: Built and tested. Publishing to the live site stays a deliberate manual step by the operator, never automatic. Where the assistant cannot reach its reasoning service it now says which condition it hit and keeps answering from the last saved snapshot instead of going silent.
headline: ARIA / AXIS is in active build and is now voice-operable. Three faults fixed this cycle: the spoken name was not recognised by real browsers, every failure reported the same vague message, and the priorities view carried no dates — dates are shown only where a real one exists, never invented. Sent: 0. Meetings 0, revenue none. Tests: 1074 pass, 0 fail, 372/372 suites; site suite 81/81.
note: Public status headline only. Detailed build state is operator-internal and served only to authenticated operators inside the AXIS command centre. This public feed never carries commit, branch, or operator-script detail.
